D: A freshman who wants to make music mash-ups joins Barden's all-female a cappella group and pushes them to try something new before the finals.
P: Serve the burritos when Bumper throws his burrito at Fat Amy from the bus.
S: Devilled eggs with paprika. Alice says Chloe's breath smells like egg.

Simmer the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool them in iced water and peel. Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard and lemon juice. Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites. Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.
Buttermilk popcorn chicken, fried crisp. Beca auditions with Cups.

Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt. Mix the flours, garlic powder and paprika and toss the chicken through until coated. Fry in batches in oil at 180C until golden and cooked through. Stir the sriracha into the mayo and serve the chicken in paper cups with the dip.
500g chicken thigh fillets, cut in small pieces@Meat
M: Beef and bean burritos, the kind Bumper throws at Fat Amy.

Cook the rice. Brown the mince and onion with the spices, then stir in the beans and a splash of water and simmer. Warm the tortillas and fill each with rice, beef, cheese, sour cream and salsa. Roll up tightly, tucking in the ends, and toast seam side down in a hot pan.
Ladies of the '80s pulled pork sliders
Pulled pork sliders with slaw, for the Ladies of the '80s riff-off in the empty pool.

Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and half the sauce and bake at 150C until it pulls apart. Shred the pork and toss with the rest of the sauce. Mix the cabbage with the mayo. Fill the rolls with pork, slaw and pickles.
W: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base. For the riff-off afterparty.

Crush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin. Beat the cream cheese and 170g sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest. Pour over the base and bake at 150C until just wobbly in the middle, then cool in the oven with the door ajar. Simmer the berries with the rest of the sugar until saucy and serve warm over slices.
K: Vodka, cranberry and lime punch in red cups. Before the pitch-slapping.
Stir the vodka, cranberry and lime juice in a jug. Pour over ice in red cups and top with soda.
